description: This is a test module for the AgentFieldClient's execution paths. It contains unit tests using pytest and responses to mock HTTP interactions, focusing on testing the client's execute_sync method across various scenarios including synchronous and asynchronous calls, error handling, retries, context propagation, headers, streaming, timeout, different execution modes, caching, and event stream handling.

classes.name: ExecutionContext
classes.description: A class representing the execution context, including identifiers and agent instance, used to manage workflow metadata.

methods.name: client()
methods.description: Fixture that creates and returns an instance of AgentFieldClient with a base URL.

methods.name: test_call_sync_execution(client)
methods.description: Tests a standard synchronous execution flow, mocking the async start and status polling endpoints, and asserting a non-None response.

methods.name: test_call_async_execution(client)
methods.description: Tests an async execution path with mocked responses for initiation and polling, asserting response correctness.

methods.name: test_call_with_context_headers(client)
methods.description: Validates that execution context headers are properly propagated during the call.

methods.name: test_call_error_handling(client)
methods.description: Ensures the client raises an exception when a response with error status is received.

methods.name: test_call_retry_logic(client)
methods.description: Simulates transient failures and checks whether the client retries and succeeds.

methods.name: test_call_with_webhook_config(client)
methods.description: Tests passing webhook configuration via input data and verifies successful execution response.

methods.name: test_call_header_propagation(client)
methods.description: Checks that custom headers from the workflow context are sent with the request.

methods.name: test_call_event_stream_handling(client)
methods.description: Verifies handling of event stream responses during execution.

methods.name: test_call_timeout_handling(client)
methods.description: Ensures that timeout errors are correctly raised and handled.

methods.name: test_call_with_different_execution_modes(client)
methods.description: Simulates different modes of execution and verifies responses.

methods.name: test_call_result_caching(client)
methods.description: Tests whether repeated calls with identical input utilize caching to avoid redundant requests.

methods.name: test_call_with_custom_headers(client)
methods.description: Checks that custom headers are properly included in the request.

methods.name: test_call_context_management(client)
methods.description: Validates that execution context is correctly set and retained during calls.

methods.name: test_call_error_response_handling(client)
methods.description: Ensures errors from server responses are properly handled and exceptions raised.
